# FamilyBridge

> Privacy-conscious recovery support and family coordination for people affected by addiction.

FamilyBridge helps people in recovery, their families, and authorized professionals coordinate support through shared communication, actions, decisions, boundaries, and follow-through. It is a support and coordination platform, not a medical provider, mental health provider, treatment program, emergency service, or substitute for professional care.

## Canonical website

- Website: https://familybridgeapp.com/
- Public support: https://familybridgeapp.com/support
- Privacy policy: https://familybridgeapp.com/privacy
- Terms of service: https://familybridgeapp.com/terms

## Who FamilyBridge serves

- Families supporting a loved one during addiction recovery
- People in recovery who want clearer, shared support
- Treatment providers and recovery professionals who receive explicit, limited authorization from a family
- Interventionists and family-support professionals coordinating appropriate next steps

FamilyBridge does not give professionals unrestricted access to private family information. Professional access is recipient-bound, capability-limited, time-limited, revocable, and dependent on authorization.

## What FamilyBridge helps coordinate

### Shared family communication

FamilyBridge gives a family one organized place for recovery-related communication. The goal is to reduce scattered conversations, clarify what was actually decided, and keep next steps visible without shame or coercion.

### Shared actions and decisions

Families can document actions, assign ownership, record decisions, and follow through on agreed next steps. The platform is designed to make family support more consistent and understandable.

### Boundaries and financial coordination

FamilyBridge can help families organize boundaries and coordinate financial requests, pledges, receipts, and shared decisions. These tools support transparency; they do not make financial, legal, or clinical decisions for users.

### Recovery support check-ins

The platform includes recovery meeting check-ins and support tools. A check-in is a coordination signal, not proof of sobriety or a clinical assessment.

### AI-assisted organization and guidance

Some FamilyBridge features use AI to organize authorized information, identify documented patterns, and suggest questions or next steps for human consideration. AI output is not a diagnosis, clinical judgment, prediction of recovery, or guarantee of an outcome.

### Authorized professional collaboration

Families may choose to share limited information with an authorized provider or professional. FamilyBridge supports privacy-conscious handoffs and controlled collaboration while keeping private family and professional information segregated.

## Public pages

### Main platform pages

- [Homepage](https://familybridgeapp.com/): FamilyBridge overview for families and recovery support.
- [Family plan](https://familybridgeapp.com/family-purchase): Current family plan information and signup.
- [For treatment providers](https://familybridgeapp.com/for-providers): How authorized provider collaboration works.
- [Provider plan](https://familybridgeapp.com/provider-purchase): Current provider plan information.
- [Product demo](https://familybridgeapp.com/demo): Overview of the FamilyBridge demonstration experience.

### Existing support tools

- [Recovery meeting check-ins](https://familybridgeapp.com/meetings): Meeting-finder and check-in tools.
- [Enabling exercise](https://familybridgeapp.com/enabling-exercise): A guided exercise for examining family support and enabling patterns.

### Existing feature explanations

- [FIIS recovery intelligence](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/fiis-intelligence): AI-assisted organization of documented family and recovery-support patterns.
- [Recovery trajectory](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/recovery-trajectory): Visual organization of recovery-related progress and concerns for human review.
- [Document analysis](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/document-analysis): Extraction of boundaries, commitments, and action items from authorized documents.
- [Medication consistency](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/medication-compliance): User-directed medication scheduling and consistency tools; not prescribing or medical advice.
- [Financial coordination](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/financial-coordination): Shared review of requests, pledges, receipts, and family decisions.
- [Care transitions](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/care-transitions): Authorized, privacy-conscious support for provider handoffs.
- [Conversation coaching](https://familybridgeapp.com/features/conversation-coaching): AI-assisted prompts for calmer, non-shaming communication.

## Safety and limitations

FamilyBridge is not an emergency or crisis service. In the United States, call 911 for immediate danger and call or text 988 for a mental health or suicide crisis. FamilyBridge does not diagnose addiction or mental illness, provide medical treatment, prescribe medication, guarantee recovery, forecast readiness, or predict individual outcomes.

## About the founder

FamilyBridge was founded by Matt Brown, an addiction interventionist with more than 20 years of experience and long-term personal recovery. The platform reflects a family-systems approach centered on compassion, honesty, boundaries, shared responsibility, privacy, and sustained family recovery.
